name: Amazonas
summary_text: This division was covered by the dedicated country dossier, which identified no deviation from the national position material enough to score separately (±0.02); it is therefore assessed at the national score. The dossier's official-vs-NGO data caveat applies here too: absence from the departmental homicide lists is weak evidence of safety, not proof of it.

sources.title: The transphobic murder that has shocked Colombia | International | EL PAÍS English
sources.claim_summary: National English-language press (14 April 2025): profile of Sara Millerey, a 32-year-old trans woman from Bello (near Medellín, Antioquia) who was brutally assaulted in a viral video and died from her injuries; her mother's remembrance and friends' recollections. An Antioquia case carried as national context; no Amazonas-specific finding.

sources.title: Sara Millerey’s brutal murder shocked Colombia. The killings didn’t stop there | CNN
sources.claim_summary: International broadcaster (6 August 2025): wave of anti-LGBTQ attacks in Colombia covered through the Millerey case and attacks on same-sex couples, framing a rising national pattern of violence. National context; no Amazonas-specific finding.

sources.title: ‘We are killed for what we are’: trans women in Colombia targeted by armed groups | Global development | The Guardian
sources.claim_summary: International daily (30 July 2024) investigation "We are killed for what we are": trans women in Caquetá targeted in social cleansing by armed groups - Tatiana Cespedes forced to move twice after death threats; documents gender-identity-driven displacement where armed actors control territory. Caquetá case carried as national-frame context; no Amazonas-specific finding.
